## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Scope

- [ ] Change is focused on one version/goal.
- [ ] No unrelated refactor was mixed into the PR.
- [ ] User-facing behavior is documented when applicable.

## Validation

- [ ] Frontend logic tests pass.
- [ ] Rust tests pass.
- [ ] Windows/Tauri build passes.
- [ ] NSIS installer is generated.
- [ ] Portable executable is generated.
- [ ] Required real-Windows smoke tests were completed.

## Security

- [ ] No token, cookie, session key, password, auth file or credential was committed.
- [ ] Sensitive provider state remains read-only/in-memory or in Windows Credential Manager as designed.
- [ ] Logs and screenshots contain no secrets.

## Documentation

- [ ] CHANGELOG is updated.
- [ ] README / SECURITY.md are updated when behavior or security changes.
- [ ] Canonical Notion documentation is synchronized in the same cycle.

## Release notes

List any known limitations or follow-up work that must remain explicit after merge.
